scope: Disposable PostgreSQL/PostGIS and pure functions; no hosted users or records modified.

results.name: complete additive migration replay and existing ordinary role creation
guest cannot read or write private visit/history tables
visits are owner-only, unique and independent from saves and feedback
optional date constraints and immutable visit ownership prevent forgery
history idempotency, published-only insert and server timestamp integrity
keyset pagination remains deterministic at identical timestamps
history clear affects only its owner and preserves visits, roles, preferences and content
date validation handles invalid calendar values, optional dates and future dates
saved search, multiple categories and timestamp/name sorting use real field shapes
new Arabic labels retain Unicode text, parity and no encoding replacement sequences
